reviews.text: We had our wood burning fireplace inspected and they determined the liner had some cracks and should be replaced. Our fireplace is see through from two rooms. We were given a price to repair.

reviews.text: These guys installed a pellet burner for me several years ago and did a terrific job. Later when I needed service, they fixed the issue under labor warranty and took it upon themselves to reseal my chimney. 100% recommend!!
